sv.title: CVC gör exit i Cary Group – Nordic Capital får sällskap av två nya storägare
sv.summary: Riskkapitalbolaget CVC säljer sin halva av det sedan några år onoterade bilglasbolaget Cary Group. Två nya storägare kliver in samtidigt som Nordic Capital återinvesterar i bolaget.

en.title: CVC Exits Cary Group – Nordic Capital Gets Two New Major Owners
en.summary: Private equity firm CVC is selling its half of the car glass company Cary Group, which has been unlisted for some years. Two new major owners are coming in while Nordic Capital reinvests in the company.
